title: Bootstrapping Symmetries in Quantum Many-Body Systems from the Cross Spectral Form Factor
summary: Symmetries play a central role in quantum many-body physics, yet uncovering them systematically remains challenging. We introduce a bootstrap framework to reconstruct the representation theory of hidden finite group symmetries of quantum many-body lattice Hamiltonians, using only a known symmetry subgroup $N$ and spectral correlations between its sectors. We introduce the cross spectral form factor (xSFF) as a subgroup-resolved diagnostic of hidden symmetry, computed via exact diagonalization to seed the bootstrap.
